description: Developed KwaraTech Academy website with a secure registration system using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB. Integrated email notifications via Nodemailer, boosting user engagement by 30%. Implemented referral codes, a dynamic certification page with search functionality, and role-based authorization for managing student certification records.

Developed Tech2Grassroots website, a dynamic web app for an NGO. Implemented secure contact and volunteer registration with Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. Delivered a seamless user experience through responsive design and optimized performance, while ensuring data privacy and security with backend best practices.

Developed and implemented a responsive, user-friendly frontend for the company’s website using modern web technologies. Built a high-performing landing page optimized for engagement and conversions, ensuring seamless functionality and cross-browser compatibility across all devices.

Developed and implemented a secure user registration and authentication system utilizing Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. Ensured efficient management of user data through password hashing, enhancing data security and streamlining access to accommodation services.

Developed and optimized the landing page, admissions page, and blog page for the Bttrschools website using WordPress. Enhanced user experience and improved site performance, resulting in a 40% increase in user engagement and contributing to the overall growth of the platform’s online presence.
